timeline.text: One day, our job-application bot woke up 17 times — and submitted exactly zero applications.
It treated brand-new employer sites as total strangers, even when it already knew their software.
Like calling every Ford dealership a mystery, just because you'd never visited that exact one.
A Playwright-based registry now recognizes the underlying platform, so a familiar system on a new site counts as known.
It checks for captchas and dead ends before waking at all — never again 17 rows, zero submissions.
